integrity: All mathematical claims are supported by direct operator identities and an exact finite-dimensional counterexample; no numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The claim corrects the converse of one published dual-\(g\)-frame criterion and gives its exact spectral boundary. It does not classify all duals beyond the mixed-operator defect equation, and an unindexed equivalent observation may exist.
title: The \(1\)-eigenspace is the exact obstruction in a dual \(g\)-frame criterion
